title: Superintelligent Software Engineering: Governance That Scales with Capability
abstract: arXiv:2610.31306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software agents are being trained to exceed human engineers; we argue that capability alone does not produce better software engineering. We define superintelligent software engineering as the discipline of building and evolving software with agents whose capability exceeds that of human engineers, in which governance (gates, contracts, decisions and decay control) scales with capability. The argument rests on three claims. First, correctness in a project rests on decisions and contracts that the code does not carry. Second, knowledge decays. Third, once an agent outpaces its reviewers, reading catches a shrinking share of the changes built on stale knowledge. A simple model shows that, past a fixed review capacity, escaping changes grow linearly with throughput while the share that reading catches falls toward zero; governance can lower the slope, capability alone cannot. translated_title: 超智能软件工程：随能力同步扩展的治理
translated_abstract: 软件智能体正在被训练以超越人类工程师；我们认为，仅有能力并不能产出更好的软件工程。我们将超智能软件工程定义为一门学科，即使用能力超越人类工程师的智能体来构建和演进软件，并使治理（门禁、契约、决策与衰减控制）随能力同步扩展。该论证建立在三个论点之上：第一，项目的正确性依赖于代码本身所不承载的决策与契约；第二，知识会衰减；第三，一旦智能体的进步速度超过其审查者，通过人工阅读所能捕获的、基于过时知识构建的变更比例将不断缩小。一个简单的模型表明，在审查容量固定的情况下，逃逸的变更随吞吐量线性增长，而阅读所能捕获的比例则趋近于零；治理能够降低这一斜率，而仅凭能力则无法做到。针对GitHub上星标最多的452个公共仓库的探索性快照（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出“超智能软件工程”概念，主张当AI智能体能力超越人类工程师时，必须让治理机制（门禁、契约、决策与衰减控制）随能力同步扩展，才能应对知识衰减与人工审查失效，保障软件正确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "superintelligent software engineering," arguing that governance (gates, contracts, decisions, and decay control) must scale with agent capability, since capability alone cannot counteract knowledge decay and the diminishing effectiveness of human code review.
